```{r Pull data from voteview.com}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(magrittr)
library(httr2)
library(quarto)
library(arrow)
library(zoo)

root <- find_project_root()
temp_path <- paste(root, "tempfiles/", sep = "/")
root_url <- "https://voteview.com/static/data/out/"
min_congress <- 96

df_path <- tibble(
  local_names <- c("votes", "members", "rollcalls", "parties"),
  remote_names <- paste("HSall", local_names, sep="_"),
  url = paste0(root_url, paste0(local_names, "/", remote_names, ".csv")),
  path = paste0(temp_path, paste0(local_names, ".parquet"))
)

write_file <- function(url, path, overwrite = FALSE, ...) {
  if (file.exists(path) & !overwrite) return(print(paste(path, "already exists, and overwrite set to FALSE. ")))
  request(url) |> 
    req_perform() |> 
    resp_body_string() |>
    I() |>
    read_csv() |>
    write_parquet(path)
}

pwalk(df_path, write_file, overwrite = FALSE)
```

```{r}
df_votes <- read_parquet(paste0(temp_path, "votes.parquet")) %>%
  filter(congress >= min_congress) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(icpsr, congress), as.factor),
    cast_code = factor(
      as.integer(cast_code), 
      levels = 0:9, 
      labels = c(
        "Not a member of the chamber when this vote was taken", 
        "Yea", "Paired Yea", "Announced Yea", "Announced Nay", 
        "Paired Nay", "Nay", "Present (some Congresses)", 
        "Present (some Congresses)", "Abstained"
      )
    )
  )

df_members <- read_parquet(paste0(temp_path, "members.parquet")) %>%
  filter(congress >= min_congress) %>%
  mutate(across(c(icpsr, state_icpsr, district_code, state_abbrev, congress, chamber, party_code), as.factor))

df_rollcalls <- read_parquet(paste0(temp_path, "rollcalls.parquet")) %>%
  filter(congress >= min_congress) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(congress, chamber), as.factor),
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date)
  )

df_parties <- read_parquet(paste0(temp_path, "parties.parquet")) %>%
  filter(congress >= min_congress) %>%
  mutate(across(c(congress, chamber, party_code), as.factor))
```

```{r}
df_ <- df_rollcalls %>%
  select(congress, chamber, date, session, rollnumber, year, month) %>%
  left_join(df_votes) %>%
  left_join(select(df_members, congress, chamber, icpsr, bioname, party_code, born)) %>%
  left_join(select(df_parties, congress, chamber, party_code, party_name, n_members)) %>%
  filter(party_name %in% c("Democrat", "Republican"))

df_sum <- df_ %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    .by = c(congress, date, year, month, rollnumber, session, party_code, party_name, n_members)
  )

options(roll_width=30, fill=NA, na.pad=TRUE, align="center")

df_sum %>%
  # filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  mutate(date = floor_date(date, unit="month")) %>%
  summarize(
    n = sum(n),
    n_members = sum(n_members),
    .by = c(date, party_code, party_name)
  ) %>%
  arrange(date) %>% 
  mutate(
    perc = n / n_members,
    perc_missing = (1 - perc) * 100,
    ma = rollmean(perc_missing, getOption("roll_width"), getOption("fill"), getOption("na.pad"), getOption("align")),
    ma_sd = rollapply(perc_missing, getOption("roll_width"), sd, fill=getOption("fill"), na.pad=getOption("na.pad"), align=getOption("align"))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(party_ma = rollmean(perc_missing, 30, fill=NA, na.pad=TRUE, align="center"), .by=party_name) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(date, perc_missing)) +
  # geom_point(aes(color = party_name), size=0.5, alpha=0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y=party_ma, color = party_name, fill = party_name), linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y=ma), linewdith=1, linetype="dashed") +
  # geom_ribbon(aes(y=ma, ymin=ma-ma_sd, ymax=ma+ma_sd), alpha=0.2) +
  stat_smooth(aes(y=perc_missing), method="loess") +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Democrat" = "blue", "Republican"="red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, NA), breaks=seq(0, 10), expand=expansion()) +
  scale_x_date(expand=expansion()) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Percent of members missing",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0, 0.9),
    legend.justification = 0,
    legend.background = element_blank()
  )
```

### Average age of members
```{r}
df_age <- df_ %>%
  mutate(
    age = year - born
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    across(age, mean),
    .by = c(year, icpsr, bioname, chamber)
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    n_over_75 = sum(age >= 75),
    max_age = max(age),
    member = bioname[which.max(age)],
    .by = c(year, chamber)
  )

df_age_total <- df_age %>%
  summarize(
    n_over_75 = sum(n_over_75),
    max_age = max(max_age),
    chamber = "Total",
    .by = year
  ) %>%
    na.omit()

df_age %<>%
  bind_rows(df_age_total)

df_age_total %<>%
  mutate(max_age = rescale(max_age, c(0, 70)))

df_max_members <- df_age %>%
  filter(chamber != "Total") %>%
  summarize(
    x = mean(year, na.rm = T),
    xmin = min(year, na.rm=T),
    xmax = max(year, na.rm=T),
    age = max(max_age, na.rm=T),
    .by = c(member, chamber)
  ) %>%
  mutate(member = str_remove(member, ",")) %>%
  separate(member, c("last", "first", "middle")) %>%
  mutate(
    last = str_to_title(last),
    first = str_sub(first, 1, 1),
    member = paste(first, last, age),
    y = ifelse(chamber == "House", 70, 80)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(age))

df_age %>%
  filter(chamber=="Total") %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, color=chamber, fill=chamber)) +
  geom_point(aes(y=n_over_75), position = position_jitter(width=0.5, height=0, seed=741)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=max_age), data=df_age_total, linetype="dashed", color="darkcyan", show.legend=FALSE) +
  # geom_segment(aes(y=y, x=xmin-0.8, xend=xmax-0.2), data=df_max_members) +
  # geom_segment(aes(y=y-2, yend=y+2, x=xmin-0.8), data=df_max_members) +
  # geom_segment(aes(y=y-2, yend=y+2, x=xmax-0.2), data=df_max_members) +
  stat_smooth(aes(y=n_over_75), linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.25, show.legend=FALSE) +
  # geom_label_repel(aes(x, y, label=member, color=chamber), data=df_max_members, inherit.aes=F, force=10, show.legend = FALSE, ylim=c(70, NA)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Total" = "black", "House" = "blue", "Senate"="red")) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("Total" = "black", "House" = "blue", "Senate"="red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0, NA), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10), sec.axis=sec_axis(~., name="Max Age of Members", breaks = seq(80, 100, 5))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion()) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Members over 75",
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color="darkcyan"),
    legend.title=element_blank(),
    legend.position="top"
  )
```
